## HAPI v0.26.0.1

### Compared with the previous maintained release

Rebuilt from current `upstream/main` (`807fa72a`) after official `v0.26.0`. Inherits upstream Antigravity (`#1320`) by operator decision because it is already on the official tip. Carries open PRs `#1359`, `#986`, `#955`, and `#906`, and keeps the fork schema repair that idempotently adds `session_scratchlist.attachments` for hubs polluted by `v0.25.1.1`.

### Compared with the official release

Adds searchable Android share-target session picking (`#986`), project-group context actions (`#955`), mid-turn Steer for Codex/Cursor (`#906`), legacy usage-model fallback preservation (`#1359`), the maintained distribution overlay (four-part tags, release-from-main, macOS `xyz.hapi.cli` signing, app-shell no-store headers), and the polluted-schema attachments repair.

### Maintained-fork guarantees

Release tags are published only from commits contained in `main`; macOS artifacts retain the `xyz.hapi.cli` signing identity; app-shell cache headers remain no-store. PR `#1320` is present because official `upstream/main` already merged it and the operator authorized inheriting that base.
